subject.title: feat(ui): add native external-link routing contract

question: Should OpenClaw accept `openclawLink` with `{type, url, target}` as the UI-to-native contract for the macOS external-link sidebar follow-up?
rationale: This is a new native-host product and security boundary, and the PR carries the protected `maintainer` label, so automation should not decide the permanent contract shape.

options.title: Accept This Bridge Contract
options.body: Proceed with this UI-side bridge and require the macOS follow-up to validate URLs and targets before opening external content.

options.title: Revise Contract Before Merge
options.body: Ask for a narrower or versioned message shape, extra origin/source fields, or explicit host-validation notes before this becomes the native contract.

options.title: Review With macOS Consumer
options.body: Defer merging until the WKWebView sidebar consumer is available so the full boundary can be reviewed together.

recommendation.title: Accept This Bridge Contract
recommendation.body: Proceed with this UI-side bridge and require the macOS follow-up to validate URLs and targets before opening external content.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the paired product direction in the linked issue and has recent history in the affected macOS and Control UI paths.
